profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer
profile.summary:
What really drew me into this field started with my 𝗽𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗹𝗲 𝗸𝗶𝗱, my parents would always tell stories of me dismantling all my toys into its ground parts. Just seeing how fascinated I was with 𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼𝗴𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝘂𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝘁 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸 𝗶𝗻 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀, making new variations of toys by the day. Since then, I have been 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘁𝘆𝗽𝗲𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗽𝘂𝘇𝘇𝗹𝗲𝘀, whether it is brain teaser games or understanding the philosophy/psychology of why people act the way they do.

Within my previous job, I worked as a 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗿 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘁-𝘂𝗽 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆 where I created countless stories about a people’s current situation using solely mortgage statements. Where I would determine if they are in financial trouble or deceased, and 𝗼𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮 𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗼 𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗲𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗶𝗿 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗴𝗴𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗺𝗼𝘃𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱. Since leaving the job, 𝗜 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗜 𝗮𝗺 𝗶𝗻 𝗹𝗼𝘃𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗼𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿𝘀, but wanted to be more than just a regular employee. I wanted to be an essential player within my company. 𝗠𝗼𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱, 𝗜 𝘄𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝗮 𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗹𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘁𝘆, 𝗯𝗲𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗱𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽 𝗶𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗵𝗲𝗹𝗽 𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗴𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝗱𝘃𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗲.

𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀:
𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘁-𝗲𝗻𝗱: JS/ES6, React.js, Styled-Components, Jest/Enzyme, Mocha/Chai,  HTML, CSS3+, Python, jQuery, Webpack, Babel, Git/Github
𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸-𝗲𝗻𝗱: Node.js/Express, MongoDB/Mongoose, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS, EC2, Docker

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented a full stack application using Java, Spring, and MySQL in the backend, while Angular with Bootstrap in the front-end to save customer information after product release. 
• Architected the front-end using Angular and Typescript with routing functionality to expand the amount of use experience.

positions.title: Back-End Software Engineer/PartialTable
positions.description:
◦  Constructed and executed an entirely new back-end architecture with over 100 million data. Tested with over 4,000 virtual users and mimicked 1,000 requests per second to record and analyze solutions to increase UI experience. Implemented a Nginx proxy server with load balancing configuration to help aid crowd control on my service when deployed on AWS EC2. 

◦  Technologies: (JS/ES6, Express, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Nginx, Webpack, New Relic, k6, Loader.io, AWS EC2)

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer/One Night Meal
positions.description:
◦  Designed a full-stack application on a food recipe integration service within 3 days that allows users to  experience a romantic evening with home-cooked recipes despite being in this day and age of the quarantined lifestyle. Users' choices vary from selecting different cuisine, dishes, preference upon nutritional qualities, location of ingredients, and cooking instructions.

◦  Technologies: (JS/ES6, React JS, Styled-Components, Express, Node.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, Webpack, Nodemon)

positions.title: Front-End Software Engineer/Techish
positions.description:
◦  Developed a RESTful API restaurant full-stack web application for business display and user experience to view restaurants’ descriptions and make reservations. Added functionality to choose around 100 different restaurants, make reservations, view customer reviews, and select similar restaurants with photos showcasing the food. Used Docker to ensure separation of concerns of my service and deployed on AWS EC2 to allow better scalability of capacity. 

◦  Technologies: (NodeJS, React, Styled-Components, Express, MySQL, Jest/Enzyme, Webpack, Docker, AWS EC2)

positions.title: Data Miner
positions.description: Responsible for going through up to a few hundred listings per day, carefully analyzing which option would be beneficial to the growth of the company.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: YMCA of the USA (National Resource Office)
volunteerExperiences.description:
◦  Given the opportunity to provide assistance in the community and give guidance to kids that I once saw in myself.
◦  Coached a team of 8 talented individuals to become better versions of themselves in the end.

company.name: YMCA of the USA (National Resource Office)

volunteerExperiences.description:
Anti-Cancer Walk

Organized a team of 10 individuals to promote the awareness of concerning issues around cancer. Granted the honor of owning our own station to aid raising money and provide support to participants in the walk.


Homeless Shelter Food Drive

Organized a team of 5 individuals to donate food, and provide assistance in providing our community the basic necessities they are unable to meet. Recognized within ourselves the feeling of social connectedness of providing others what we are blessed with, but deprived in others.


Asian-American Bone Marrow Cancer

Organized a whole organization philanthropy event to raise awareness about bone marrow cancer linked with leukemia within the UCI community. Received recognition within my University; but most importantly, within ourselves to being able to create miracles for others reaching others for help.
